A1.justification: Both 23-page PDFs contain the same EchoVLM study, including Appendices A–G. Complete text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish matching scientific content, equations, tables, and figures without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original report-generation, diagnosis, and VQA experiments, ablations, and appendix entity-level and out-of-distribution evaluations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 2–7 and the evaluations in Appendices F–G.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendix B retain the identical data-generation pipeline, Dual-path MoE architecture, two-stage training procedure, and losses.

E1.justification: Both use the same seven-system clinical ultrasound corpus for report generation, diagnosis, and VQA, plus the same public breast, liver, and thyroid OOD evaluation in Appendix G.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the main comparisons, appendix evaluations, and case studies. Baselines including Qwen2-VL, Lingshu, and LLaVA-Med are neither added nor removed from corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: The 27,577-image, 3,000-report test set, greedy decoding, model configurations, training budgets, and NLP and entity-level evaluation metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Shared-expert, routing-strategy, and expert-count ablations in Tables 5–7 are identical, as are the routing, attention, case-study, and OOD analyses in Appendices C–E and G.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point-estimate reporting, without repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results match, including appendix evaluations and case-study outputs. For example, Table 2 retains EchoVLM (11B)'s average report-generation BLEU-1 of 53.87.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(9) and their mathematical definitions are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about EchoVLM's novelty, dataset, instruction-generation pipeline, MoE adaptation, and empirical performance.

C2.justification: The vascular-data imbalance and VQA limitations in Section 6, routing and attention interpretations in Appendices C–D, and nodule false negatives in Appendix E are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A's prompts and processing thresholds, Appendix B/Table 9's training and hardware details, and the code/model-weight access statement are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, Table 1's comparison with prior ultrasound datasets, citation membership, and the complete reference list are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2, 17 Apr 2026, to v3, 27 Jul 2026. Body text, author information, headings, section ordering, and appendix structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–16, Tables 1–12, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match outside the first-page version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and visual presentation are unchanged throughout both papers and Appendices A–G. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp provides no meaningful gain or loss in overall paper quality.
